description: This file manages user status functionalities within the Mattermost platform, including setting, updating, broadcasting, and retrieving user statuses, as well as handling status-related cache and cluster messaging.

classes.name: PlatformService
classes.description: Service managing user statuses, including cache, database, and cluster communication.

methods.name: AddStatusCacheSkipClusterSend
methods.description: Adds a user status to cache without sending cluster message.

methods.name: AddStatusCache
methods.description: Adds a user status to cache and sends cluster message if cluster is available.

methods.name: GetAllStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves all user statuses from cache.

methods.name: GetStatusesByIds
methods.description: Retrieves statuses for given user IDs, filling from DB if cache misses occur.

methods.name: GetUserStatusesByIds
methods.description: Retrieves statuses for user IDs as a list, filling from DB if needed.

methods.name: BroadcastStatus
methods.description: Broadcasts user status change via WebSocket event.

methods.name: SaveAndBroadcastStatus
methods.description: Saves user status to database and broadcasts change.

methods.name: GetStatusFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves a user's status from cache.

methods.name: GetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a user's status from cache or database.

methods.name: SetStatusLastActivityAt
methods.description: Updates last activity timestamp and sets status to away if needed.

methods.name: UpdateLastActivityAtIfNeeded
methods.description: Updates session's last activity timestamp if timeout exceeded.

methods.name: SetStatusOnline
methods.description: Sets user status to online, updates cache, database, and broadcasts.

methods.name: SetStatusOffline
methods.description: Sets user status to offline, updates cache, database, and broadcasts.

methods.name: SetStatusAwayIfNeeded
methods.description: Sets user status to away based on last activity and configuration.

methods.name: SetStatusDoNotDisturbTimed
methods.description: Sets user status to DND with expiry time, truncating expiry to align with job schedule.

methods.name: truncateDNDEndTime
methods.description: Truncates DND expiry time to align with scheduled expiry job interval.

methods.name: SetStatusDoNotDisturb
methods.description: Sets user status to DND manually.

methods.name: SetStatusOutOfOffice
methods.description: Sets user status to Out of Office.

methods.name: isUserAway
methods.description: Determines if user is considered away based on last activity timestamp.

methods.name: QueueSetStatusOffline
methods.description: Queues offline status update for performance during high load.

methods.name: processStatusUpdates
methods.description: Processes batched status updates, saving to database and broadcasting.

methods.name: _setStatusOfflineAndNotify
methods.description: Sets user status to offline and notifies via shared channel service.
